title: IEEE Young Professionals Committee - Oversight AdHoc Committee Member
description: The Oversight Ad Hoc Committee is established to provide strategic guidance, coordination, and governance oversight for the defined initiatives of the IEEE Young Professionals Committee during the 2026 term. The committee is responsible for ensuring alignment with IEEE's mission, Young Professionals' strategic priorities, and objectives, while promoting transparency, accountability, and measurable impact. The committee will define the initiatives' scope, milestones, and success metrics while monitoring progress, risks, and dependencies, and providing timely recommendations. It will also facilitate coordination across relevant IEEE organizational units and stakeholders and ensure outcomes are documented and positioned for scalability or long-term adoption within IEEE. The committee operates for a fixed duration (e.g, 1 year) or until its mandate is fulfilled, after which outcomes, recommendations, and lessons learned are formally reported to the IEEE Young Professionals Committee.

title: Essential Professional Skills  - Pilot Program - Student Branch Leaders

title: Volunteers needed to Peer Review IEEE eLearning courses
description:
The IEEE Educational Activities team is seeking qualified subject matter experts to provide peer reviews of existing and in-progress eLearning courses. Existing courses need to be reviewed to determine if they are still accurate and relevant for IEEE members and customers. In-progress courses need to be reviewed to ensure they meet the highest of IEEE educational standards and are ready to be launched. We are seeking volunteers with expertise especially in the areas of computing, power and energy, software engineering, transportation electrification, and vehicular technology. We ask that all applicants please submit your resume and indicate your area of expertise per the IEEE fields of interest (ex: Computing, Power and Energy, Robotics, etc).

title: Member and leader for IEEE VTS IS3C-MI Technical Committee

title: Content strategist -  IEEE Women In Engineering
description: The IEEE Women In Engineering podcast team is inviting motivated volunteers to serve in the podcast subcommittee for 2026/2027. For this role, we are looking for creative and strategic volunteers to serve as Content Strategists. This role is ideal for individuals who are good with copywriting, social media posts, audience engagement, branding, and content storytelling. As a Content Strategist, you will help shape the podcast’s messaging, audience experience, and promotional strategy. You will work closely with the Podcast Lead and Host to ensure that each episode aligns with IEEE WIE goals and resonates with listeners across the global engineering community. Responsibilities Support development of podcast themes and messaging Create episode titles, summaries, and show notes Develop promotional and audience engagement content Support social media and outreach planning Ensure consistency in tone, branding, and communication Improve visibility and audience engagement

title: Mentoring Meet - VSeat Experience Specialist
description: The VSeat (Virtual Seat) Experience Specialist will support mentoring programs by promoting virtual seats and strengthening cross-border mentoring partnerships. By working closely with organizers, VSeat Experience Specialist shall aptly coordinate and advertise VSeat opportunities through the MM Portal and YP social media channels. The role involves working with both Deputy Leads in the team and dynamically handling situations. Having previous MM Experience is essential to apply for this position.

title: Volunteer Web Developer - Educational STEM & Financial Literacy Game for Kids (Virtual)
description:
This project can be used as a university senior design project 

We are piloting an activity in NJ, but if it is successful it can be used across USA and then adapted to other countries.

We are seeking a Web Development team (3-5 students) to build a lightweight, browser-based educational game designed for K-12 students. The goal of the game is to introduce kids to exciting STEM careers while teaching fundamental financial literacy skills (e.g., earn, spend, save, invest) in an interactive, playful way.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design and code a simple web game accessible directly through standard browsers.
- Turn content outlines (careers, financial decisions, mini-scenarios) into fun game mechanics (e.g., interactive choices, points system, progress paths).
- Collaborate with our team to refine graphics, layout, and child-friendly UX/UI elements.
- Test the platform for responsiveness and ease of use.

The game needs to run from a Google Chromebook.

Project dates are estimates.

title: IEEE Colombia Section - EAC Committee - Call for volunteers 2026
description: 🚀 Unete al equipo del Comite de Actividades Educativas, EAC IEEE Colombia! Si te apasiona la educación, la tecnologia y el impacto social, esta es tu oportunidad para formar parte de un grupo que impulsa la inspiración STEM/STEAM en todo el país. Estamos buscando voluntarios para diferentes roles: Webmaster, Tesorero, Secretario Coordinadores y Subcoordinadores Regionales EAC Apoyo al programa IEEE Colombia STEAM Ambassadors. Requisitos: ser miembro IEEE, tener disponibilidad minima de 1 o 2 horas semanales y muchas ganas de contribuir al desarrollo educativo y social. Postulate hasta el 1 de Diciembre!

title: Regions 1+2 Young Professionals Vice Chair for Social Media
description: Regions 1+2 YP is looking for a Vice Chair for Social Media to help us share our exciting activities and fantastic opportunities. As a key member of our team, you would be responsible for driving our social media strategy and work with our team to regularly create and post content on instagram and linkedin.

title: Video Content Coordinator
description: The "Director" of the training series. You will manage the production timeline, ensuring that scripts move to filming and editing on schedule. You act as the bridge between technical experts providing the knowledge and the creative team producing the visuals.

title: IEEE Lafayette Section Young Professionals Committee Member
description: IEEE Young Professionals is an international community of IEEE members and volunteers who have graduated from their first professional degree within the past 15 years. This dynamic group focuses on elevating professional images, expanding global networks, connecting with local peers, and giving back to their communities. By encompassing recent graduates, experienced professionals, and entrepreneurs, IEEE Young Professionals offers a diverse range of opportunities and resources to support career development and personal growth.

title: IEEE Young Professionals Green Legacy Volunteer
description:
Join IEEE Young Professionals Green Legacy Week 2026, a global tree planting and environmental stewardship initiative organized in celebration of the 30th Anniversary of IEEE Young Professionals.

As a Green Legacy Volunteer, you may support local tree planting activities, environmental awareness, event logistics, community engagement, tree monitoring, and impact storytelling.

Volunteers can participate through IEEE Young Professionals Affinity Groups, Sections, Student Branches, or approved Green Legacy Week activities.

This opportunity is open to individuals passionate about sustainability, service, and creating a greener future.

Tagline: Rooted in service. Growing for tomorrow.

title: Graphic Designer | IEEE MGA Student Activities Committee | Electronic Communications Subcommittee
description: We are looking for a visually creative and detail-oriented Graphic Designer to bring the IEEE Students brand to life. From social media visuals to website assets and event materials, you will be the visual voice of a global student community spanning 160+ countries.  KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Design visuals for social media platforms including Instagram, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and Facebook - Create website banners, thumbnails, and graphic assets for students.ieee.org - Develop promotional materials for IEEE student events, campaigns, and initiatives - Maintain visual consistency with IEEE's brand guidelines across all design outputs - Collaborate with the content and web teams to ensure visuals complement written and digital materials  WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR - Proficiency in design tools such as Figma(Preferred), Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, or Canva - Strong understanding of typography, color theory, and visual hierarchy - A portfolio of previous design work is highly encouraged

title: IEEE YP Green Legacy - Region Ambassador
description:
IEEE Young Professionals Green Legacy is an initiative focused on encouraging sustainability, environmental awareness, and meaningful action within the IEEE community. Region Ambassadors will help connect the Green Legacy initiative with IEEE Young Professionals and volunteers across their assigned region.

As a Region Ambassador, you will promote Green Legacy activities, encourage participation in sustainability-related initiatives, support communication and outreach, and help strengthen collaboration among IEEE volunteers and organizational units.

Key Responsibilities:
• Promote IEEE YP Green Legacy initiatives and activities within the assigned region.
• Engage with IEEE Young Professionals, Sections, Chapters, and other relevant IEEE communities.
• Encourage participation in sustainability, environmental, and community-focused activities.
• Share Green Legacy opportunities, resources, and updates through appropriate IEEE communication channels.

title: STEM Workshop Volunteer Opportunity - Inspire the Next Generation
description:
Join IEEE volunteers in supporting a large-scale STEM workshop for pre-university students (ages 12-18) and educators at Mar Baselios College of Engineering & Technology, Trivandrum, Kerala, India. The event is expected to welcome approximately 1,000 students and teachers, providing a unique opportunity to inspire future innovators and introduce young learners to the exciting world of science, technology, engineering, and mathematics.

Volunteers will support a variety of activities, including:

Facilitating IEEE REACH hands-on learning activities and discussions with students.
Assisting with event registration and participant support.
Guiding attendees throughout the campus.
Representing IEEE societies at information tables.
Supporting demonstrations, hands-on activities, and interactive sessions designed for younger audiences.

This is a great opportunity to inspire future innovators, develop leadership and communication skills, expand your network, and make a meaningful impact.
